title: Mandela
desc: In a small village, two political parties compete in the local elections and are ready to win at any cost. In a twist of fate, the single deciding vote comes down to a small-time barber.

title: Thittam Irandu
desc: While her marriage preparations are underway, Inspector Athira is busy investigating the death of her friend Deepa. Later, her life turns upside down when the whole mystery unfolds before her eyes.

title: Manam
desc: Bittu, a six-year-old, loses his parents in an unfortunate car accident. Thirty years later, he comes across two collegians who look exactly like his late parents' young selves.

title: Rangasthalam
desc: A young man suffering from a hearing defect rises up against a corrupt local leader along with the help of his fearless older brother. Together, they defy tyranny in a fight for justice and freedom.

title: Cadaver
desc: When two surgeons mysteriously get murdered by Vetri, a prisoner, the responsibility of locating his accomplice falls on the shoulders of a pathologist.

title: Bhimaa
desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.

title: Rangoon
desc: Julia journeys to the Indo-Burma border to perform for the troops during World War II, on the insistence of Billimoria, her lover. There, she finds herself enamoured by Jemadar Malik, a soldier.

title: Pudhukottai Azhagan
desc: The heir to a large estate is killed by his conniving relatives. Meanwhile, his lookalike, a gangster, falls in love with a singer and impersonates a software engineer to impress her.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Deva Dassu
desc: Dr Das, a reserved man, finds his routine life upended when Deva, a fugitive gangster on the run from police, seeks refuge in his clinic. Over time, a profound friendship blossoms between them.

title: Kadhalil Sodhappuvadhu Yeppadi
desc: After the end of his romance with Parvati, Arun befriends Cathy, John's girlfriend. Things take a chaotic turn when John mistakes their bond for love instead of friendship.

title: Draupathi
desc: Accused of his wife's murder in an alleged honor killing, Rudra Prabhakaran is jailed. Subsequently, he descends into a dark path of vengeance after posting bail.

title: Eeswaran
desc: Periyasamy's sons decide to visit him with their families. While Eeswaran, his caretaker, oversees the preparations for this visit, he takes it upon himself to protect the family from danger.

title: Sathiya Sothanai
desc: Pradeep's life turns upside down when he is accused of a murder after discovering the dead body of an influential villager along with some precious jewels.

title: Double Ismart
desc: A dying criminal enlists a rogue scientist to transfer his mind into a savvy street renegade, using a special brain port. Chaos and adventure ensue!

title: Thug Life
desc: Adopted by a gang leader, Amaran faces suspicion after an assassination attempt.
